item.title: Honey Badger vs Everything: Why Africa's Deadliest Animals Can't Kill It (Full Episode)
item.description:
A honey badger fights lions, takes cobra bites, and walks away. This is the full story of the animal scientists call the most fearless predator in Africa — and why nothing has managed to kill it.In this full episode of Apex Files, we break down the real biology behind the honey badger's reputation: the loose, puncture-resistant skin that lets it twist out of a big cat's jaws, the documented venom resistance that lets it survive a cobra bite, and the aggression that makes a 10kg mustelid charge an animal twenty times its size.Then we follow the confrontations — honey badger vs lion, honey badger vs hyena, honey badger vs cobra and black mamba — and separate what the research actually documents from what the internet invented.Built from published wildlife research and documented field accounts.If you want the next episode the moment it lands, subscribe — new Nature Frontiers documentaries every week.
